title: Mechanical Systems
description: Mechanical Systems as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are mechanisms, moving parts and kinematic envelopes identified?
Are loads and duty cycles of mechanisms estimated?
Are mechanical failure modes (jamming, wear) identified?
Are clearances to moving parts assessed through the full range of motion?
Are lubrication, wear and adjustment provisions defined?
Are rigging and adjustment features defined?
Are mechanism clearances confirmed in the integrated model at all positions?
Are rigging, adjustment and lubrication instructions defined?
Are functional test requirements for mechanisms defined?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
